items.statement: The investigation defines and reports a reproducible candidate-generation and stopping procedure for activation of propargyl bromide.
items.expected: Hypotheses and candidates retain identity, mapped structures, per-candidate validation context, and a coverage/stopping rationale.

items.statement: The selected candidate is validated as a transition state connecting the intended activation valleys.
items.expected: Frequency and IRC/equivalent connectivity evidence support the selected candidate, with explicit charge and multiplicity.

items.statement: The selected validated activation candidate has a reported activation Gibbs free energy in the requested units and reference state.
items.expected: A numeric ΔG‡ in kcal/mol is reported with transparent thermochemical construction, or a scientifically specific bounded-failure result is supplied.
